Our standing agreement with Shree Balaji Steel Traders Pvt Ltd (V001) allows for the approval of freight charges that are **₹5,000 or less per trip**, even when those charges are not explicitly included on the purchase order.

The team has consistently applied this policy to resolve exceptions for this vendor:

*   **12 March 2026**: Approved invoice SBST/2526/0948 (₹2,900 freight charge) because it was under the ₹5,000 cap.
*   **07 March 2026**: Approved invoice SBST/2526/0945 (₹4,100 freight charge) because it was under the ₹5,000 cap.
*   **02 March 2026**: Approved invoice SBST/2526/0938 (₹3,850 freight charge) as it was within the standing agreement limit of ₹5,000 per trip.

All freight charges exceeding this limit or invoices requiring further exception handling must be managed in accordance with standard organizational controls, including escalation to the Finance Controller for invoices exceeding ₹5,00,000.
